rules.value: After a hospital revival from a death to a non-player character at level >= 5: RezSickness (effect 196) at stack 1..3 lowering Body, Mind and Spirit by 20% a stack (truncated), lasting 120 s, each further revival while traumatized adding 120 s up to 360 s; RezSicknessNoHeal (effect 195) for 30 s blocks healing; expiry restores the attributes.
citations: tooltiplanguage 506: 'Reduces attributes by 20% for a duration of 2 minutes. Subsequent deaths while traumatized cause additional penalty and duration to be added up to maximum of 60% and 6 minutes.'
uielementlanguage 5687: trauma for being killed by a non-player character or a clan-war enemy, not in duels; two minutes plus two for each resuscitation up to six
rules.reasoning: the rules and values are original; applying them at level 5, the truncation and the choice of the three primary attributes are inferred

gaps.summary: Revive by another player (RequestRevive/RefuseRevive/ReviveRequestInfo, BuryMe with canRevive) is not implemented; canRevive is always 0. Final-client data: Cure 3/5 revive at 50% health and armor with no death penalty; Tools pumps 3-5 at 10/25/50%.
Death is not persisted: a player who disconnects while dead logs in alive at the death position with full health.
No control-point ownership exists, so control-point hospitals are always offered once gained.
Maps without a catalogued hospital offer none; ReviveMe then revives in place (emulator fallback). Only contexts 1985 and 1220 are catalogued.
Respawn facing is unrecovered (A4-39 measured heading 16 deg, medium confidence, convention not mapped); the player keeps their facing.
Trauma rounding, whether derived pools also fall, trauma kits (items 3266-3285, ATTRIBUTE_MAX_CHANGE, 60 s reuse, DEATH_PENALTY_REDUCED 300) and PvP clan-war deaths are not implemented.
